title: Turnitin says it detected unauthorized activity involving certain customer-facing systems
date_note: The CEO letter quoted by BleepingComputer is dated 23 November; the article gives no incident date.
geo_basis: company headquarters (not stated by the source)
summary: BleepingComputer reports that Turnitin said it detected unauthorized activity involving certain customer-facing Turnitin systems. The company says it activated its incident response plan, hired external cybersecurity specialists and notified law enforcement and cyber regulators. Turnitin says its systems are fully operational and safe to use; the article says it is not disclosed whether user data was accessed.
plain: Turnitin says it found unauthorized activity on some customer-facing systems and has called in outside experts. It says its systems are operational and safe to use.
exec: Turnitin has confirmed unauthorized activity on customer-facing systems; per BleepingComputer it has not said whether user data was accessed.

validation.note: BleepingComputer and Daily Security (Korea) each report Turnitin's disclosure of unauthorized activity; Daily Security says the CEO notice was dated 23 November and that Turnitin did not disclose intrusion or detection dates or whether account data or submissions were taken. Turnitin's own letter (helpcenter.turnitin.com, 403) was not read.

review.note: Title, 23 Nov date, confirmed status, no-data-disclosure wording checked against BleepingComputer and Daily Security
